criteria.text: Statin request path: preferred atorvastatin, lovastatin, pravastatin or simvastatin, or another statin.

Patient has compliantly taken atorvastatin, lovastatin, pravastatin or simvastatin for 75 of the last 90 days without acceptable LDL reduction OR experienced an adverse drug reaction with those preferred agents.

notes: Partial encoding of Statin Electronic Step-Edit Criteria: when electronic step-edit does not result in automatic coverage, these criteria determine coverage. Rules engine is the sole eligibility evaluator.
Listed agents: Advicor, Altoprev, Crestor, Lescol, Lescol XL, Lovastatin, Lipitor, Livalo, Mevacor, Pravachol, Pravastatin, Simcor, Simvastatin, Vytorin and Zocor.

FDA approved indications vary by product; all products are used for hypercholesterolemia or hyperlipidemia. Consult product prescribing information for the complete indications. No product-specific indication lists are encoded.

Coverage is given for atorvastatin, lovastatin, pravastatin or simvastatin. Other statins require compliant preferred-agent use for 75 of the last 90 days without acceptable LDL reduction OR an adverse drug reaction with the preferred agents. The ADR alternative does not require a 75-day trial.
Dispensing (notes only): 30-day supply. Quantity limit is 1 tablet/day except Lescol, Mevacor and Lovastatin: 2 tablets or capsules/day.
